title: Hyderabad's minimum fell 2.6°C in a day to 17.9°C

slides.head: Hyderabad's minimum fell 2.6°C in a day to 17.9°C
What happened
slides.body: Hyderabad's mornings turned cooler, close to seasonal normal.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Temperatures had been running nearly 3°C above normal.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Golconda weather station in Hyderabad logged 15°C on Nov 17; Kohir in Sangareddy hit 11.2°C.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Hazy mornings until Nov 23; IMD expects minimums of 18-19°C and maximums of 30-32°C through Nov 25. Ask: Will the cyclone's clouds cut the morning chill or add rain?

Hyderabad's minimum fell 2.6°C in a day to 17.9°C

IMD recorded 17.9°C on Thursday morning, down from 20.5°C, near the 17.6°C normal. Minimums are expected at 18-19°C and maximums 30-32°C from Nov 20 to 25, with isolated light to moderate rain in Telangana on Friday and Saturday.

Why it matters: Temperatures had been running nearly 3°C above normal.

Source: Times of India. Image: Times of India
